name: Vietnamese Tofu Noodle Bowl
ingredients: ¼ cup each mint, coriander and Thai basil
Dressing: juice of 2 limes, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 garlic clove (minced), 1 red chilli, 1 tbsp water
steps: Cook the vermicelli per the pack; rinse in cold water and drain.
Sear the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden on all sides.
Divide the noodles, lettuce, sprouts, carrot and cucumber between two bowls.
Top with the tofu and herbs and drizzle with the dressing.
note: The dressing uses lime and soy rather than sugar, in contrast to the usual nuoc cham.
